about.title: A family-owned Houston shop that answers the phone itself.
text: HVAC247PRO was founded in 2009 with a clear mission: give Houston homes and businesses reliable, professional HVAC service whenever they need it. What started as a small team of technicians has grown into a full commercial and residential contractor covering the Greater Houston metro area.
Climate control here is not only about comfort. It protects a business, its equipment and its bottom line, which is why the emergency line is answered 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.

The team is licensed, bonded and insured, holds EPA and NATE certification, and stays current with the systems and techniques coming into the trade. We are family-owned and Houston-local, not a national franchise.

faqs.q: What HVAC services do you offer in Houston?
faqs.a: AC repair, AC installation, heating repair, furnace installation, ductless mini-split systems, duct cleaning, indoor air quality solutions and preventive maintenance plans, for both residential and commercial properties across Houston and 23 surrounding cities.

faqs.q: Do you offer 24/7 emergency HVAC repair?
faqs.a: Yes. Whether the AC breaks down at midnight or the heater fails on a holiday, our licensed technicians are ready to respond. The emergency line is answered by a live person, not a voicemail.

faqs.q: What brands of HVAC equipment do you install?
faqs.a: We install and service all major HVAC brands, including Carrier, Trane, Lennox, Rheem, Goodman, Daikin and York. Our technicians are factory-trained and can recommend the best system for your budget, home size and efficiency goals.

faqs.q: How do I know if I need AC repair or a full replacement?
faqs.a: Consider replacement if the system is over 10 to 15 years old, needs frequent repairs costing more than 50% of a new unit, uses R-22 refrigerant, which has been phased out, or your energy bills have risen significantly.

faqs.q: Do you provide free estimates for HVAC work?
faqs.a: Yes, free estimates on all HVAC installations and major repairs. On a service call there is a diagnostic fee, and it is credited back toward the repair when you approve the work.

faqs.q: How much does a new AC unit cost in Houston?
faqs.a: A new AC installation in Houston typically ranges from $3,500 to $8,500 depending on system size, SEER rating and the square footage of the building. Call us for a quote based on your own system.
